policy: Install selected capabilities from official origins; resolve current compatible stable versions at setup and record the actual result locally. No third-party implementations are bundled.

ponytail.installation: Follow the current official host plugin or extension instructions; native plugin state requires host verification. Shared foundation guidance is the fallback.

graphify.installation: Use the current supported uv/pipx package installation and host integration instructions at the origin.

rtk.capability: Compact command output with full diagnostic fallback
rtk.installation: Use the current official release or Cargo installation. Verify this is Rust Token Killer before configuring host hooks.

markitdown.installation: Use the supported package installer with only the document extras needed by the project.

openspec.installation: Use the current supported npm package installation from the official documentation.

security-audit.activate_when: Authentication, authorization, untrusted input, sensitive data, or an explicit audit request
security-audit.considerations: Use guidance mode for focused review; full audit needs explicit scope and upstream sandbox/subagent prerequisites.

wireflow-review.activate_when: A multi-screen product has unsettled navigation, recovery, or state retention
wireflow-review.considerations: Review the wireflow before visual polish; reconcile accepted decisions into project specs.

floorplan.activate_when: An existing application needs architecture explanation or onboarding
floorplan.considerations: Alternative to Graphify for human-facing maps; verify map claims against source.

astryx.activate_when: A React 19+ product needs a component system and accepts the current beta maturity
astryx.considerations: Evaluate against existing components and bundle/design constraints; do not migrate an established system by default.

anatomy.activate_when: The product needs an explanatory machine or system illustration
anatomy.considerations: Use only for a requested visual deliverable; inspect exported assets and rendering dependencies.

diorama.activate_when: A product explicitly needs an interactive 3D scene
diorama.considerations: Three.js is the relevant library; review GPU/mobile cost, asset rights, and a usable fallback.

ecc.capability: Engineering skills and agent harness integrations
ecc.activate_when: A specific missing engineering capability is identified
ecc.considerations: Select individual components; do not replace foundation authority, memory, hooks, or review lifecycle with the whole harness.

line-art-animation.activate_when: A product brief calls for line-art motion
line-art-animation.considerations: Check reduced motion, performance, and framework compatibility.

grill-me.activate_when: The user requests a deeper assumption interview beyond the existing question model
grill-me.considerations: Foundation-supported interview integration in workflow/grill-me.md preserves one-question pacing and existing authority. The wrapper depends on grilling; both remain separately installed upstream skills.
grill-me.installation: Follow workflow/grill-me.md: install grill-me and grilling from the same reviewed upstream revision into the consuming project using its supported host installer; verify discovery and record actual results locally.

caveman.capability: Short responses and compact tool output
caveman.activate_when: Measured context/output cost persists after concise prompts or RTK
caveman.considerations: Proxy and host changes need separate configuration opt-in; preserve exact diagnostics, code, contracts, and original output access.

agent-browser.activate_when: Interactive inspection needs a browser and an existing host browser tool is insufficient
agent-browser.considerations: Choose one interactive driver; it complements rather than replaces repeatable application tests.

playwright.activate_when: A web product has critical user journeys to verify
playwright.considerations: Use project test dependencies and current browser/system prerequisites; record passing runs, not merely screenshots.

find-skills.activate_when: The curated catalog and existing host capabilities do not meet a concrete task
find-skills.considerations: Discovery is not an installation instruction; inspect the selected upstream skill and its dependencies.

anti-ui-slop.activate_when: A UI needs design direction or finish review
anti-ui-slop.considerations: free skills and optional authenticated/paid MCP are separate choices. Choose this or unslop as primary aesthetic guidance.

unslop.activate_when: An existing interface needs a focused design refinement
unslop.considerations: Alternative to anti-ui-slop; retain brand, usability, and accessibility. Check attribution terms and optional image/video dependencies.

web-design-guidelines.activate_when: A web UI is implemented or changed
web-design-guidelines.considerations: Use alongside rendered keyboard, responsive, and error-state checks; a source review alone does not prove accessibility.

canvas-design.activate_when: A product needs a poster, static artwork, or supporting visual asset
canvas-design.considerations: Static deliverables only; this is not an interactive app layout or HTML canvas implementation tool.

openseo.activate_when: A public indexable product has an SEO research requirement
openseo.considerations: Candidate identity only: OpenSEO names several projects. Confirm the intended origin and API/hosting costs before installing.

openproject.activate_when: The team already uses OpenProject or explicitly needs its planning capabilities
openproject.considerations: Define integration and source-of-truth ownership; do not create an automatically competing task queue.

voicestudio.activate_when: A product needs voice, transcription, dubbing, or audio assets
voicestudio.considerations: Candidate identity only: confirm intended project; evaluate model licenses, storage, hardware, and deployment fit.

appflowy.activate_when: The team uses AppFlowy for shared knowledge
appflowy.considerations: Treat as a workspace integration; define which records remain authoritative in Git.

skillspector.capability: Inspect third-party agent skills before activation
skillspector.activate_when: A new or changed external skill bundle is being considered
skillspector.considerations: Use inspection without executing candidate code; choose static versus model-backed analysis deliberately. Scanner findings require triage and do not certify safety.

hookify.activate_when: Repeated concrete behavior needs deterministic enforcement in Claude Code
hookify.considerations: Review event scope, test expected and nonmatching cases, preserve existing hooks, and provide disable instructions; not a portable hook engine.

claude-code-setup.activate_when: A Claude Code project needs tailored setup advice
claude-code-setup.considerations: Recommendations do not authorize configuration. For Codex and agy use foundation setup and current native host capabilities instead of inventing equivalent plugins.

ralph-loop.activate_when: A bounded implementation task has objective checks and benefits from repeated repair
ralph-loop.considerations: Require finite iteration/time/cost limits, cancellation, and stagnation handling. A completion phrase is not test evidence; never default to unlimited loops.

commit-commands.activate_when: A Claude Code user requests commit or publication automation
commit-commands.considerations: Native git/gh remain the portable fallback; committing, pushing, PR creation, and branch/worktree cleanup have separate scopes of authorization.

addy-agent-skills.activate_when: A task needs a particular review, debugging, testing, or interview capability
addy-agent-skills.considerations: Select one relevant skill and dependencies; avoid bulk-loading the collection or duplicating existing foundation policies.

context7.activate_when: A dependency API is uncertain or has changed
context7.considerations: Match the actual dependency version, inspect cited docs, and fall back to official documentation if unavailable; review current service access limits.

21st-mcp.activate_when: A compatible frontend needs component references or generated components
21st-mcp.considerations: Use current 21st MCP setup linked by the origin, rather than a new legacy Magic proxy installation; check credentials, service cost, component terms and fit.

strix.activate_when: An explicit security test needs executable validation on an authorized target
strix.considerations: Specify target and permitted actions, isolated environment, resource/model budget, and exclusions; source review does not authorize live exploitation.

defaults.installation: Follow the entry integration guide and current official upstream installer; verify and record actual results locally.
